<div class="card-body">
'''Yavin Sentry''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの歩哨</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">２フォース消費し、任意のヤヴィン４の位置カードに配備する。“歩哨”が警戒している間、その場所及び、隣接した位置カードに、次のいずれかの効果を適用できる。１：相手の配備コストに＋１。２：相手が、戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値に＋１。３：自分の合計戦力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-68o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の歩哨たちは、高所センサー・プラットフォームにて任務につき、帝国の偵察隊等の危険に備える。収集された追加データは、ヤヴィン基地のメインセンサーに送られる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yavin Sentry.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy at any Yavin 4 site. While the sentry is on watch, you may apply one effect there and at adjacent sites. 1. Opponent's deploy cost +1. 2. Ability opponent needs to draw battle destiny +1. 3. Your total power +1.

'''Lore:''' Rebel sentries serve on elevated sensor platforms to watch for Imperial scouts and similar threats. The additional data they collect is sent to Yavin Base's main sensor.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yavin Sentry]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
